usage.title: Help improve Aegis
usage.explain: Share an optional activity signal? Random ID, version and activity dates only. No sensors, games or sessions are sent. The server stores a pseudonymous hash. Your choice does not limit any feature.
usage.decline: Decline or disable and request deletion
usage.feedback.help: What helped? What got in the way? What is missing? Choose email or GitHub and review your message before sending.
usage.enabled: Optional usage reporting enabled. A signal is sent at most every 15 minutes, including while minimised.
usage.disabled: Optional usage reporting disabled. No activity signal is sent.
usage.deleting: Reporting disabled. Deletion pending a connection; no new activity signals.
usage.internal: Internal run: no activity signal is sent.
